name: Tablo Tuner
description: Connect Dispatcharr to a tablo-bridge playlist: creates the M3U account, the XMLTV source, one channel per stream with the Proxy profile, and the EPG mapping, and re-syncs them when the Tablo's lineup changes.
author: jkoehler11

fields.label: Bridge URL
fields.help_text: Base URL of the tablo-bridge container as Dispatcharr sees it.

fields.label: Channel stream profile
fields.help_text: Locked profile for these channels. Anything but Proxy runs the stream through streamlink/VLC/ffmpeg, which fails on a raw TS.

fields.label: Channel profile (optional)
fields.help_text: Also add the channels to this Dispatcharr channel profile.

fields.label: Proxy startup timeout (s)
fields.help_text: A Tablo takes 6-11 s to allocate a tuner; the 8 s default declares the channel dead before the first byte.

actions.label: Set up Tablo live TV
actions.description: Idempotent: account, guide, channels, profiles, EPG mapping.

actions.label: Re-sync channels
actions.description: Refresh the playlist and add, rename or retire channels.

actions.label: Show status
actions.description: Read-only summary of what is configured and what is missing.
